sources.label: CRM account record
sources.text:
Account: Northstar Engineering (FICTIONAL)
Employees: 2,400 · engineering org ~600
Opportunity: Portal Enterprise, $480K ARR, Stage 3 - Technical evaluation
Account owner: Jamie Chen (AE)
Close date: Q1 2027. Procurement wants a 45-day POC before signing.
Champion: Maya Patel, Head of Platform Engineering

sources.label: Discovery call with Maya
sources.text:
[00:02] Maya Patel (Head of Platform): Honestly our platform team spends too much time walking other teams through the same service setup.
[00:05] Maya Patel: every new team asks us the same questions about ownership, docs, CI
[00:09] Chris: Where would you start?
[00:11] Maya Patel: Probably payments-api. It's on GitHub, repo northstar/payments-api.
[00:14] Maya Patel: I think the payments team owns it but honestly nobody knows who owns half our services.
[00:18] Maya Patel: Runbooks are in Confluence, mostly out of date.
[00:22] Dev (SRE): We're on GitHub Actions now, we used to run Jenkins.
[00:25] Maya Patel: Budget is tight this year so we need to show value quickly.

sources.label: Chris's notes
sources.text:
Maya is a strong champion but her VP is sceptical. Don't mention pricing to engineers.
payments-api catalog-info.yaml is half done according to Maya.
Security review might be needed later - unclear.

sources.text:
